//! What the names port asks of the outside, in the core's own vocabulary.

use super::errors::NamesError;
use super::types::{Asked, Greeting};

/// What every names adapter implements.
pub trait NamesPort {
    /// The greeting stored for the name asked for.
    ///
    /// # Errors
    ///
    /// `NamesError::Missing` when no greeting is stored for the name.
    fn stored(&self, asked: &Asked) -> Result<Greeting, NamesError>;
}
